bid(uint256[],uint256).details: Bids are first-come commitments, not price auctions. `_bondAmount` is a security deposit; posting more than the required bond does not give priority and cannot outbid an existing active bid. `transferIndexes` is a list, so a single bid can reserve many rows in one call.

collect(((bytes,bytes,bytes,bytes,uint25.details: Unproved rows remain reserved under the same bid and deadline. After completing all state changes, settlement attempts to pay each asset directly. Only a failed asset payout is retained in `claimable` for later withdrawal.

expireBid(address).details: Expiry is explicit and bounded by the number of rows in this bid. This avoids scanning every bidder during unrelated bid, collect, or cancellation calls.

expireBids(address[]).details: Active, missing, and duplicate entries are skipped so one stale input cannot prevent other expired bids from being cleaned up.

is_bonded().details: Previously this scanned every bidder and returned true only when at least one bid's five-minute deadline had not passed. This O(1) check also returns true for such bids, but expired bids remain outstanding until `expireBid` or `expireBids` releases them, matching the state that blocks cancellation.

withdrawClaim(address).details: State is cleared before the external transfer. A failed transfer reverts and restores the claim, without affecting already-settled rows.

bid(uint256[],uint256).notice: Place a bid on a subset of expected transfers by posting a bond.

collect(((bytes,bytes,bytes,bytes,uint25.notice: Permanently settle a non-empty proved subset of the caller's active bid.

expireBid(address).notice: Release one expired bid's unfinished rows and forfeit its remaining bond.

expireBids(address[]).notice: Release any expired bids in a caller-supplied bounded list.

is_bonded().notice: Whether any bid still requires settlement or explicit expiry.

withdrawClaim(address).notice: Withdraw the caller's accrued settlement claim for one asset.
